fields.name: QOSSymptoms_dttemp01
fields.fieldText:
DETERMINE THE SYMPTOMS


Specify the call quality symptom(s) experienced by the customer(s).


  • Choppy / Garbled Audio: audio is cutting in and out, or missing words / syllables
  • Audio Loss: audio went silent but the call timer is still running
  • One-way Audio: one party hears the audio, the other party doesn’t for the entire duration of the call (if it’s not entire duration of call, it can be classified as Audio Loss)
  • No Audio: absolute silence on both ends of the call
  • Audio Delay: more than two (2) seconds of audio delay on either party resulting to overlapping conversation
  • Echo: hears an echo of his/her own voice
  • Robotic Voice: audio sounds robotic or synthesized
  • Noise: can hear the conversation but with static noise, crackling or buzzing sound in the background
  • Dropped Calls: call gets disconnected onset of the call, or mid-call (the timer stops and phone goes back to home screen/idle.)
